en: A vintage postcard showing a canal scene in Bruges, Belgium. The canal is flanked by historic brick buildings on the left and a tree-lined path with people walking on the right. The image has a slightly faded, hand-colored look typical of early 20th-century postcards. The text at the top reads 'Bruges. — Le Quai de la Main d’Or.' Additional text at the bottom credits M. Marcovici, Edit., Brux.
